name: Machined In Wood
old_description: Machined In Wood is a custom CNC woodworking shop that specializes in CNC machined wood projects, laser engraving, and finishing of custom one of a kind pieces, prototypes, and small to medium scale manufacturing.
about:
Machined In Wood operates from Bellingham, Massachusetts. The shop began as a home-based business and has expanded to serve both individual clients and commercial manufacturers.

The company provides custom CNC woodworking services including V-carving, 3D carving, precision machined parts, and profile cuts in sheet goods. It also offers laser cutting and engraving with CO2 and diode lasers, 3D printing for prototyping, traditional woodworking (table saw, band saw, jointer, planer, drum sander, router, sanding), and painting and finishing such as hand painting, airbrushing, HVLP spraying, stains, clear coats, and food-grade finishes. Two 48" x 48" CNC routers (one with pass-through capability) and a horizontal boring machine support production runs from dozens to hundreds of parts.

Customers range from individual hobbyists and makers to other wood shops and commercial firms. The shop works with engineers and designers on production parts, accepting customer-supplied material and collaborating via blueprints, CAD models, and GD&T specifications. Projects include one-of-a-kind pieces, prototypes, and small-to-medium scale manufacturing for clients across the United States.

Machined In Wood differentiates itself with equipment that many small shops do not invest in, notably a horizontal boring machine for precise horizontal holes and the ability to flatten material up to 48" x 48" on its CNC routers. The company emphasizes proficiency with technical drawings and GD&T, maintains a 1% tolerance level, and conducts rigorous QA inspections. It also takes on smaller projects that larger shops often decline.
